name: North Korea
famous_for: Massive monument architecture in Pyongyang, Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, Mount Paektu sacred volcanic crater, and Arirang Games.
tourists: Approx. 100,000 visitors (strictly regulated group state tours); famous for Juche Tower, DMZ border crossing, and Kaesong ancient gates.
must_know: Bow respectfully before statues and portraits of state founders; all tourist activities are accompanied by official national guides.
fun_fact: The Ryugyong Hotel in Pyongyang is a colossal 105-story pyramid-shaped skyscraper that dominates the skyline.
